title: What the Campus Tour Skips: 10 Places Students Share With Each Other
description: Ten named Stevenson spaces for studying, creating, gathering, dining, and campus life across Owings Mills.

cards.title: Ratcliffe Community Center
cards.subtitle: Owings Mills South Campus
cards.notes: Use this community-center stop when your schedule runs late; Stevenson lists Ratcliffe as open around the clock, seven days a week.
cards.short_summary: A 24/7 campus building for flexible meetups and student-life errands.
cards.evidence_claim: Stevenson lists Ratcliffe Community Center as open 24 hours a day, seven days a week.
cards.access_notes: University hours page lists Ratcliffe Community Center as open 24/7; follow any building-access requirements.

cards.title: Rockland Center
cards.subtitle: Owings Mills South Campus
cards.notes: Make Rockland a daytime or evening rendezvous point; its banquet room hosts speakers, career fairs, academic events, and student activities.
cards.short_summary: A campus hub that combines dining, events, and student-life offices.
cards.evidence_claim: Stevenson says Rockland Center's banquet room hosts guest speakers, career fairs, academic events, and student activities.
cards.source_title: Rockland Dining Hall Tour | Stevenson University
cards.access_notes: Stevenson lists Rockland Center hours as 6:30 a.m. to midnight daily; event access varies.

cards.title: Rockland Marketplace
cards.subtitle: Inside Rockland Center, Owings Mills South
cards.notes: Meet over a meal or take food to go; Stevenson identifies Rockland Marketplace as its main dining facility with varied food options.
cards.short_summary: The university’s main dining facility in Rockland Center.
cards.evidence_claim: Stevenson describes Rockland Marketplace as its main dining facility and places it on Rockland Center's first floor.
cards.source_title: Rockland Dining Hall Tour | Stevenson University
cards.access_notes: Food is a paid dining service; review current meal-plan or retail-payment options before visiting.

cards.title: Rockland Banquet Room
cards.subtitle: Second floor of Rockland Center
cards.notes: Check the student-events calendar for talks, fairs, and activities scheduled here; the room is a designated venue rather than open seating.
cards.short_summary: A second-floor event room used for campus programs.
cards.evidence_claim: Stevenson states that the Rockland Banquet Room hosts guest speakers, career fairs, academic events, and student activities.
cards.source_title: Rockland Dining Hall Tour | Stevenson University
cards.access_notes: Access is event-dependent; consult the organizer or Student Life for current programming.

cards.title: Wild Stang Radio
cards.subtitle: Rockland Center, first floor
cards.notes: If audio or hosting interests you, contact the program to ask about participating; Wild Stang welcomes students from every major.
cards.short_summary: A student-run digital-radio outlet with on-air and production opportunities.
cards.evidence_claim: Stevenson says Wild Stang Radio is open to all students from any major and is located in Rockland Center.
cards.access_notes: Participation requires contacting the student-broadcasting program; do not assume studio access without arrangement.

cards.title: Garrison Hall Coffee House
cards.subtitle: Garrison Hall, Owings Mills South
cards.notes: Use this as a quick coffee-and-conversation stop between commitments; Stevenson identifies it as its campus Starbucks location.
cards.evidence_claim: Stevenson states that it serves Starbucks at the Garrison Hall Coffee House.
cards.access_notes: Food and beverages are sold here; confirm current service hours and payment options before going.

cards.title: Garrison Student Union
cards.subtitle: Owings Mills South Campus
cards.notes: Coordinate a group meeting around the union’s posted lobby access windows, and use a student SUOne card when the schedule requires it.
cards.short_summary: A central student-union building with published lobby-access hours.
cards.evidence_claim: Stevenson publishes separate general and SUOne-card access hours for the Garrison Student Union's North Lobby.
cards.access_notes: North Lobby public hours vary by day; student card access extends some evening hours. Check the official hours page.

cards.title: Learning Commons
cards.subtitle: Kevin J. Manning Academic Center, Owings Mills North
cards.notes: Reserve a study room or presentation-practice room for collaborative work, and use the computer teaching lab when your project needs it.
cards.short_summary: A flexible research and collaboration space with rooms and a teaching lab.
cards.evidence_claim: Stevenson's 2025–26 catalog says the Learning Commons has a computer teaching lab, three study rooms, and a presentation practice room.
cards.access_notes: Located at Owings Mills North; room availability and reservation procedures may vary by term.

cards.title: Owings Mills Library
cards.subtitle: Brown School of Business and Leadership, Owings Mills
cards.notes: Start research here when you need print sources or legal-studies materials, then ask library staff about finding additional academic resources.
cards.short_summary: A campus library with broad print holdings and the Legal Studies print collection.
cards.evidence_claim: Stevenson's 2025–26 catalog places the Owings Mills Library in the Brown School of Business and Leadership and notes its print legal collection.
cards.access_notes: Library access and service hours can change; check Stevenson Library for current hours before a dedicated study trip.

cards.title: School of Design Gallery
cards.subtitle: School of Design, Owings Mills North
cards.notes: Drop in to view current design-focused exhibitions, or plan around a gallery talk; the space adjoins the School of Design’s atrium lobby.
cards.short_summary: A free gallery for exhibitions in design, illustration, photography, motion graphics, and video.
cards.evidence_claim: Stevenson says the School of Design Gallery is free and open to all, and that it presents design-related exhibitions.
cards.access_notes: Stevenson lists gallery hours as Monday–Friday 11 a.m.–7 p.m. and Saturday 11 a.m.–4 p.m.; closed Sunday.
